title.en: Cell-current Picard relaxation and Green feedback
title.zh: 单元电流 Picard 松弛与 Green 反馈

summary: Mask a toroidal current-density grid, convert it to cell currents, relax those currents against the previous state and project flux and optional field responses through dense Green matrices.

identity.relation: toroidal current density and prior cell-current state to relaxed Green-response flux and poloidal field
identity.direction: j_phi, R-Z grid, mask, old currents, relaxation, Green matrices and vacuum state -> new psi, BR, BZ and current state
identity.definition: For a uniform tensor-product grid, set inactive j_phi cells to zero, flatten in C order, multiply by absolute dR*dZ to obtain raw cell currents, and form I=(1-relax)*I_raw+relax*I_old. Then psi=psi_vac+G_psi@I. If both field Green matrices are supplied, BR=br_vac+G_br@I and BZ=bz_vac+G_bz@I; otherwise the vacuum field components are returned unchanged.
identity.model: one explicit cell-current Picard feedback step using caller-provided dense linear Green responses
identity.geometry: uniform tensor-product R-Z grid with at least two samples on each axis; axes may increase or decrease
identity.coordinates: all fields indexed [Z,R], and Green rows/columns use C-order flattened grid points and source cells
identity.boundary: No wall or free-boundary condition is solved here; supplied vacuum fields are the additive reference state.
assumptions: j_phi has units A/m^2 and a cell is represented by the positive area abs(dR*dZ).
The caller's Green matrices match the declared cell-current ordering and SI response units.
relax weights the previous cell-current state, not the previous flux.

inputs.name: j_phi
inputs.description: Toroidal current density before optional plasma clipping.
inputs.constraints: Same shape as the grid; inactive cells become zero when a mask is supplied.

inputs.name: r_grid
inputs.constraints: At least two points per axis, rows repeat one uniform nonzero radial axis within the implementation tolerances; descending axes are allowed.

inputs.name: z_grid
inputs.constraints: Same grid shape; columns repeat one uniform nonzero axial axis within the implementation tolerances; descending axes are allowed.

inputs.name: plasma_mask
inputs.description: Optional active-cell selector, passed explicitly as None when absent.
inputs.constraints: None means all cells active; otherwise exact grid shape and boolean dtype, without broadcast or 0/1 coercion.

inputs.name: currents_old
inputs.description: Previous relaxed cell-current state, passed explicitly as None for zero initialization.
inputs.constraints: None initializes all zeros; otherwise exact flattened length and finite values.

inputs.name: relax
inputs.description: Retention weight of the old cell-current state.
inputs.constraints: 0 <= relax <= 1; 0 uses raw current, 1 retains the old state.

inputs.name: g_psi
inputs.description: Dense current-to-flux Green response for psi=R A_phi.
inputs.constraints: Required, exact square shape; rows are field points and columns are C-order source cells.

inputs.name: g_br
inputs.description: Optional current-to-radial-field Green response, passed explicitly as None when absent.
inputs.constraints: Must be supplied as a finite exact square matrix together with g_bz, or both must be None.

inputs.name: g_bz
inputs.description: Optional current-to-axial-field Green response, passed explicitly as None when absent.
inputs.constraints: Must be supplied as a finite exact square matrix together with g_br, or both must be None.

inputs.name: psi_vac
inputs.description: Vacuum or external psi=R A_phi offset.
inputs.constraints: Exact grid shape; added to the g_psi response.

inputs.name: br_vac
inputs.constraints: Exact grid shape; returned unchanged when field Green matrices are absent.

inputs.name: bz_vac
inputs.constraints: Exact grid shape; returned unchanged when field Green matrices are absent.

outputs.name: psi
outputs.description: Vacuum psi=R A_phi plus relaxed-current Green response.
outputs.constraints: The matrix response uses C-order flattened cell currents.

outputs.name: BR
outputs.description: Vacuum radial field plus optional Green response.
outputs.constraints: Equals br_vac when both field Green matrices are None.

outputs.name: BZ
outputs.description: Vacuum axial field plus optional Green response.
outputs.constraints: Equals bz_vac when both field Green matrices are None.

outputs.name: j_phi
outputs.constraints: Zero outside True cells when a mask is supplied.

outputs.name: initial_picard_current_state
outputs.description: Zero current vector for graph zero-step initialization.
outputs.constraints: Always zeros, independent of supplied currents_old.

outputs.name: picard_current_state
outputs.description: Relaxed C-order flattened cell-current vector used by the Green projections.

outputs.name: plasma_currents
outputs.constraints: Masked j_phi times abs(dR*dZ); unlike picard_current_state, no old-state relaxation is included.

preconditions: The dense matrices represent the caller's chosen linear Green response in the same C-order cell-current basis.
The grid is a uniform tensor product, and the optional plasma selector has exact boolean grid shape.
supported: One masked, relaxed cell-current projection with optional paired magnetic-field response on ascending or descending uniform axes.
excluded: Nonuniform cell areas or automatic Green-matrix construction.
Flux relaxation, field derivation from psi, wall correction or convergence decisions.
A guarantee that the supplied Green response describes a physically valid equilibrium.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for wrong-rank, wrong-shape or nonfinite fields and matrices, non-tensor or nonuniform/zero-spacing grids, fewer than two points on an axis, nonboolean or wrong-shaped mask, malformed old-current state, out-of-range relaxation or unpaired g_br/g_bz.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: NumPy matrix-arithmetic failures propagate; finite inputs that overflow a matrix product are not postvalidated for finite outputs.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; this Operator performs exactly one feedback step and no convergence check.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial dictionary is returned after input or matrix-operation failure.

provenance.lineage_summary: Maintained SciRel relation mapped to a saved Pleiades L1 Picard-feedback Operator and direct tests; historical review labels are development provenance, not expert recognition of this version.
source_kinds: saved L1 Operator contract and implementation

python.signature: update_anisotropic_picard_flux(j_phi, r_grid, z_grid, plasma_mask, currents_old, relax, g_psi, g_br, g_bz, psi_vac, br_vac, bz_vac)

example.description: A two-by-two active-cell pattern distinguishes raw and relaxed currents and tests all three Green projections.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.equilibrium import update_anisotropic_picard_flux
r, z = np.meshgrid([0.2, 0.4], [-0.1, 0.1])
j = np.array([[1.0, 2.0], [3.0, 4.0]])
mask = np.array([[True, False], [False, True]])
old = np.array([0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.5])
result = update_anisotropic_picard_flux(j, r, z, mask, old, 0.25, np.eye(4), 2*np.eye(4), -np.eye(4), np.zeros((2,2)), np.ones((2,2)), 2*np.ones((2,2)))
raw = np.array([0.04, 0.0, 0.0, 0.16])
relaxed = 0.75*raw + 0.25*old
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['plasma_currents'].ravel(), raw)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['picard_current_state'], relaxed)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['psi'].ravel(), relaxed)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['BR'].ravel(), 1.0 + 2*relaxed)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['BZ'].ravel(), 2.0 - relaxed)
example.expected: Only two cells carry raw current, and flux/field outputs use the relaxed current vector.

scope: Zero Green response and positive cell area.
Active-mask clipping, raw versus relaxed currents and paired flux/field response.
A selected off-source grid point matches direct circular-filament psi=R A_phi, BR and BZ without a 2*pi factor.
Unpaired field matrices, wrong masks and nonuniform grids are rejected.
Uniform descending axes retain positive cell area.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct small-grid tests cover discrete current weighting, matrix projection and selected validation failures. One finite off-source circular-filament comparison supports the per-radian flux convention, not arbitrary Green-matrix physics, convergence or expert recognition.
known_limitations: The caller must provide explicit None for optional physical inputs because the Python signature has no defaults.
Cell area uses the uniform first spacing rather than a quadrature rule for irregular grids.
Public distribution licensing and expert recognition remain pending.
